summary: DraftKings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a second amendment to its credit agreement, adding a $700 million Term B facility due 2033 and a new $750 million revolving credit facility due 2031, replacing a $500 million facility. Net proceeds from the Term B loans are intended to repurchase a portion of its outstanding 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028, alongside general corporate purposes. This debt-financed note repurchase reduces potential dilution and leverages balance sheet, representing a capital return event. Watch for details on the repurchase size, pricing, and market reaction.
